I've been thinking about discipline lately. Discipline is really important if you want to grow. You have to show up every day, no matter how you feel. Consistency is the key, that's what separates people who succeed from people who don't. The mind is a muscle that you have to train. Habits compound over time, and small actions repeated daily lead to big results. Anyone can build the body and the mind they want if they just commit to the process and trust it. The hardest part is starting, but once you start you have to keep going. That's pretty much it.
